scope: Bounded coordinator-side temporal scoring reference; no model training or G04/G06 result rewrite.
units: Early adaptation uses assignment events; final-truth cohorts contain one anchor event per distinct key.
clock: (phase, global event order); phase end uses order=len(manifest.events). Planned predictions occur at phase end.
validity: Intervals are left-closed/right-open. new_revision ends at the next assignment; value_change ends at the first later different value. Same-value assignment IDs are never erased.
early_adaptation: Query each observed cohort event at phase_end(event.phase+offset). A known superseding event by min(due,through) censors it; otherwise a future due phase is not_yet_due. Eligible queries use the latest manifest target valid at the prediction timestamp.
final_truth_by_cohort: Query each distinct cohort key at through_phase end using the latest manifest event at that time, even when its anchor has been superseded. No historical anchor target is reused.
provenance: Every eligible case has observed_target provenance with its latest source event ID. Plans bind canonical contract and manifest hashes. Model predictions contain only case ID, declared prediction time, value or explicit abstention, and plan hash.
denominators: total=eligible+censored+not_yet_due. Primary accuracy=correct/eligible; missing eligible records and explicit abstentions count as wrong. Empty eligible denominator yields null.
validation: Reject unknown or duplicate cases, foreign plan hashes, records for ineligible cases, invalid or wrong timestamps, out-of-domain values, duplicate cohort IDs, and duplicate final-cohort keys.
state: Frozen objects and tuple records. Coordinator oracle/interval metadata is not a learner input. Receipt validation is not an authenticity/security guarantee.
storage: Default CLI and checks do not create release artifacts. Explicit output uses exclusive creation and cannot overwrite an existing file.
checks: A→B→C current/stale, B→C→B IDs, same-value policies, same-phase supersession, future-censor discipline, missing/duplicate/invalid timestamp/provenance inputs, exclusive output, read-only default.
